raw.query: WITH d AS ( SELECT run_id, window_requests, is_current AS dim_is_current, superseded_by AS dim_superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = TRUE ), medium AS ( SELECT 'burst' || e.rank_by_peak AS window_name, e.onset_min, e.peak_img_per_s FROM provenance.eda_burst_episode e JOIN provenance.v_dim ed ON ed.run_id = e.run_id WHERE e.run_id = 'eda:i_burst_anatomy' AND ed.is_current = TRUE AND ed.superseded_by IS NULL AND e.onset_min BETWEEN 35 AND 60 ), scoped AS ( SELECT m.window_name, m.onset_min, m.peak_img_per_s, p.run_id, p.lead_s, p.p99_ms, p.n_requests, d.window_requests, p.queue_divergent, p.is_current AS latency_is_current, d.dim_is_current, d.dim_superseded_by, r.is_current AS run_is_current, r.superseded_by AS run_superseded_by, b.bound_ms, (p.p99_ms <= b.bound_ms) AS passes_sla, (p.n_requests = d.window_requests) AS denominator_matches, (d.dim_superseded_by IS NOT NULL OR r.superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AS is_superseded, (p.is_current AND d.dim_is_current AND r.is_current AND d.dim_superseded_by IS NULL AND r.superseded_by IS NULL) AS _effective FROM medium m JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON p.window_name = m.window_name JOIN d ON d.run_id = p.run_id JOIN provenance.runs r ON r.run_id = p.run_id CROSS JOIN provenance.v_sla_bound b WHERE p.experiment IN ('a2','a2x') AND p.policy = 'reactive' AND p.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay' AND p.is_current = TRUE AND b.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay' ) SELECT window_name, onset_min, peak_img_per_s, COUNT(*) AS tested_leads, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE _effective) AS effective_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_superseded) AS superseded_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE passes_sla AND _effective) AS passing_leads, MAX(lead_s) FILTER (WHERE passes_sla AND _effective) AS l_star_s, MIN(window_requests) AS window_requests, MIN(n_requests) AS metric_requests_min, MAX(n_requests) AS metric_requests_max, BOOL_AND(denominator_matches) AS denominator_matches, BOOL_AND(queue_divergent = FALSE) AS all_queue_stable, JSON_AGG(JSON_BUILD_OBJECT('run_id', run_id, 'lead_s', lead_s, 'p99_ms', p99_ms, 'passes_sla', passes_sla, 'n_requests', n_requests, 'window_requests', window_requests, 'denominator_matches', denominator_matches, 'is_superseded', is_superseded, '_effective', _effective) ORDER BY lead_s) AS per_lead FROM scoped GROUP BY window_name, onset_min, peak_img_per_s ORDER BY window_name
raw.observed: encoder_delay p99 bound=1000 ms; burst2 (onset 48 min) L*=45 s with 3/4 passing and 13,870 requests; burst4 (60 min) L*=165 s with 4/4 passing, p99=904.739 ms at 165 s, and 25,639 requests; burst5 (35 min) L*=45 s with 3/4 passing and 8,983 requests. All 12 rows are _effective, 0 are superseded, and all denominator checks match.
raw.evidence: The effective per-window breakdown falsifies the universal sub-minute L*=45 s claim: burst4 passes the 1000-ms p99 SLA at 165 s; v_pool_latency also contains no pod-scheduling-latency measurement.
